answer: Locks are entered in summit, expire in jetty, and oasis lists each expiry. Anyone running 63 aliases thus needs 197 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1296 identities would post 3376 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
